race.comment: STEEL WILL (1) talented colt resuming. Thrown in the deep end when a battling seventh over 1100m in the G3 Kindgarten at Randwick last April. Primed with the two trial wins and gets the services of J Mac. Respect. PERI (8) trapped wide from the wide gate on debut and had genuine excuses with a tiring eighth over 1100m at Hawkesbury. Visors go on and has solid claims from the inside gate. ROEBUCK PLANE (9) Fastnet Rock filly from Roebuck Bay on debut for the Waterhouse & Bott yard. Latest trial win had merit and place best from the barrier. COSMIC JIVE (4) is a Cosmic Force gelding on debut for Paul Snowden. Impressed in his Gosford trial win and is expected to make his presence felt.
